show.description: A poor villager, Parth, dreams of a better life, but fate tests him at every step. When his wife Naina risks everything and even sacrifices her home to save his future, love turns into the ultimate gamble. Separated by destiny, betrayal, and time, will Parth rise to become a powerful CEO or lose the one person who believed in him the most?
